source:
@@U04459@@
Sea and shore are at peace. The sea
welcomes your rapid ships from shore,
and standing here at your palace
you can say with pride that all the world
is encompassed by your arms’ embrace.
And where else did it start but here?
The first rude hut,
a tiny scratch of a ditch to the sea,
where today your oars splash lustily in the waves.
Your noble purpose and the industry of your men
have won the rewards of earth and sea.
Standing here—

@@U04461@@
Yes, and it’s that ere,
that ere that so oppresses me!
I confess it to you, you who are so wise
in the ways of the world,
it cuts me to the very heart,
to my heart’s core,
making it impossible to bear!
And how it shames me to say it!
They, up there, the old couple,
they'll have to go. I want those lindens,
want them for myself, to sit under.
Those trees, those few trees,
those trees that are not my trees,
destroy it all,
my worldwide possessions.
In those trees I want to build platforms,
great platforms from branch to branch,
a place to stand and see the totality
of all that I have accomplished, to survey
at one glance this masterpiece
of the human mind that raises from the sea
new land for humans to live on.
This is the bitterest torment of all,
to suffer for the little one doesn’t own.
translation:
@@U04459@@
大海和海岸都很平静。海
欢迎您的快速船只从岸边驶来，
站在你的宫殿里
你可以自豪地说，全世界
被你的双臂拥抱着。
除了这里之外，它还能从哪里开始呢？
第一个简陋的小屋，
通往大海的一条小沟渠的划痕，
今天，你的桨在海浪中猛烈地拍打。
您的崇高目标和您的部下的勤奋
赢得了大地和海洋的奖赏。
站在这里——

@@U04461@@
是的，就是这样，
就这样让我如此压抑！
我向你承认，你是如此聪明
在世界的方式中，
这深深刺痛了我的心
到我的内心深处，
让人无法忍受！
说出来我是多么羞愧啊！
他们，在那儿，那对老夫妇，
他们得走了。我想要那些菩提树，
我想要它们，坐在下面。
那些树，那些几棵树，
那些不是我的树的树，
摧毁这一切，
我的全球财产。
我想在那些树上搭建平台，
从一个分支机构到另一个分支机构的伟大平台，
一个可以站立并看到整体的地方
我所完成的一切，调查
乍一看这部杰作
从海洋中升起的人类心灵
人类赖以生存的新土地。
这是世间最痛苦的折磨
为不属于自己的小孩子而受苦。
